answer: The opal counter is kept in lantern and ocean shows each reset. Someone hence has to keep each duplicate self continuously active for 47 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A bond is refunded only after 47 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A farm of 768 identities would post 2339 proofs and burn roughly 51 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
